notes: Shared macOS host, no physical devices; production FFmpeg, simulated motors, 50ms each-way / shared 2Mbps.
Before is the unmodified #41 profiler; other runs add bounded lock, worker CPU and capture-age instrumentation.
camera.capture_interval_ms is the spacing of distinct capture receipts observed at encoder submission, not every producer callback.
thread-cpu is an intrusive thread-local Python/native CPU diagnostic; it is not a direct GIL ownership/wait timer.
The cProfile/thread-clock prototype failed its CPU consistency check and was discarded; no values from it appear here.
Failed combined-load trials are retained. Quiet map5 improvement does not qualify arbitrary combined load.
